# Chita Rivera Award for Outstanding Dancers in a Broadway Show

| website =
| sponsor = New York City Dance Alliance
}}
The Chita Rivera Award for Outstanding Choreography in a Broadway Show is an annual award presented to dancers for their work on a Broadway production. The award was originally presented in 1982, initially separated by gender; the category was made gender-neutral in 2023, with two winners.
